about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Who I am & what I do
about.description: With a background in Frontend Development, I naturally gravitated toward Analytics & Power Bi  because I enjoy not only building interfaces, but also understanding what the numbers mean. I hold an MSc in Computer Science from the Technical University of Denmark (DTU), Copenhagen. I turn complex datasets into clear visuals, practical KPIs, and interactive dashboards that people can use without needing extra explanations. I'm seeking a full-time role where I can help teams make better, faster decisions through data.
